title: BNCI 2014-008 P300 dataset (ALS patients)
description: EEG recordings from eight people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a visual P300 speller task with a 6x6 matrix. Participants copy-spelled seven predefined five-character words using row-column intensification, and data were recorded from 8 channels at 256 Hz. The dataset supports research on attention and P300-based brain-computer interface performance in motor-impaired users.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a g.MOBILAB amplifier and active g.Ladybird Ag/AgCl electrodes at 8 sites (Fz, Cz, Pz, Oz, P3, P4, PO7, PO8), referenced to the right earlobe, using BCI2000 at 256 Hz. Online filtering was 0.1-10 Hz bandpass plus a 50 Hz notch. Epochs of 0-1 s were baseline corrected, and epochs exceeding ±70 μV were rejected. Classification used SWLDA.
